variants.label: sky-only
variants.note: Diagnostic: remove only aurora light. The supposed mountain disappears; the stars sit in an ordinary smooth sky above the real hills.

variants.label: cutoff
variants.note: Diagnostic: the wavy light-admission mask creates the false mountain outline; it is not the terrain mask.

variants.label: soft-glow
variants.note: Replace the abrupt hem cutoff with a continuous Gaussian fade below the curtain, keeping the existing waves.

variants.label: open-sky
variants.note: Diffuse irregular ray tips and shallower broad folds remove the mountain-like silhouette while retaining the aurora curtain.
